verdict.rationale: Formant supports alerting on anomalies, dispatching help when 'something looks wrong,' and time-synced 'intervention records,' plus teleoperation for operators to take direct control, suggesting an intervention workflow exists. However there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated human-intervention queue, assignment/resolution workflow, or an automated hand-back-to-autonomy mechanism after operator resolution. Missing for 10: explicit intervention-queue UI/workflow docs, operator resolution/hand-back-to-autonomy mechanics, and independent confirmation of this specific failure-routing flow.
